messages:
sam: Heads-up: trying a 'shadow-to-live fuse' pattern today for v3q-nf4. Idea: run shadow at ~10% but keep a live fuse that can instantly divert traffic if any gated slices exceed thresholds. Want to capture long-seq MRR drops that manifest after 30-90s.

reena: Nice. How is the fuse triggered? simple rule or ML-based classifier?

sam: start simple: multi-slice monitors. Fuse triggers when any of: exact_match_long delta < -0.03 (posterior lower 95% credible), rr_precision@5 delta < -0.02, OR confidence_entropy increase > +0.08. Also require sustained window >= 5m and n >= 800.

ana: small nit: use Bayesian posteriors not frequentist p-values for better small-sample behavior. Recommend Beta or Gaussian approx depending on metric.

kai: Agree. For rr_precision@5 we can use Beta-Binomial. For MRR Gaussian after logit transform.

dmitri: Implementation detail: the fuse should compute an online posterior using streaming counts so action latency is <10s. I'll prototype a tiny C++ microservice that subscribes to sample stream and publishes 'fuse-trip' event.

ci-bot: smoke: v3q-nf4 shadow->live @10% window=30m -> exact_match_long delta = -3.4% (posterior lower95=-0.045), rr_precision@5 -1.1%, conf_entropy +0.09, n=1240. Fuse: TRIP recommended. :rotating_light:

reena: That's a fairly strong signal. Can we check seqlen slices? Maybe it's concentrated on >2048 tokens.

sam: Yup. Slice breakdown: seqlen<512 delta ~ -0.4%, 512-2048 delta -1.5%, >2048 delta -9.8%. Looks like a long-context degradation.

ana: Possible causes: kv cache eviction mismatch under nf4 quant kernels, or decoder truncation. Has anyone seen similar in int8->nf4?

kai: We observed a drift once when kernel fallback chose aten path for >2k tokens, leading to subtle tokenization differences. Need to check kernel selection logs.

dmitri: Action items: (1) fuse trip -> auto-route:route:pin-to-stable (2) run debug-shadow with kv_warmup=900s + force-aten-disabled to check diff (3) collect per-token logprobs for failing samples and run token-level alignment check.

reena: I'll file a short runbook and kick off debug-shadow now. Linking results in ~1.5h.

sam: If fuse trips we want an automated postmortem skeleton created and notified to #eng-ml and #oncall. ci-bot can create a draft.

ci-bot: created postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/1779993210-fuse-trip-draft. Notifying @oncall and @product.

ana: One more suggestion: for the final promote, require shadow parity for >48h on the >2048 slice with n>5k before exceeding 25% global traffic.

kai: Sounds good. reena/sam - ping me when debug-shadow finishes and I'll inspect kernel logs.

sam: thanks — pausing any manual ramp until we get the debug results. :white_check_mark:
